capabilities: Maintain folder index notes with links to documents
Refresh root index and Home navigation
Filter excluded files early to reduce clutter
Run a local background worker for link upkeep
Provide manual Refresh from the status bar
disambiguation: Not a graph view or visualization plugin; it maintains folder index notes and links that the native graph and optional Graph Views display.
extras: Freemium: Free covers early filtering, manual Refresh and existing links; Full adds automatic folder-index and root/Home upkeep with a 30-day trial after sign-in. One-time prices $5.70 founders / $8.92 regular, all sales final. Windows desktop only (Obsidian 1.14.4, 1.14.5, 1.15.0); Android, macOS and Linux not supported in 1.1.4. Proprietary/closed source; account and HTTPS checks required for trial and activation; companion Graph Views is a separate free public beta.
problem: Obsidian's native graph and folder navigation do not stay current as notes and folders are added, moved, or removed, and repository noise clutters the graph.

relations.evidence: we recommend using Vault Foundations with Graph Views, also created and maintained by ARCXCOVAEL LLC

requires.name: Full license for automatic navigation upkeep

summary: Vault maintenance plugin that keeps folder index notes and root/Home navigation links current, with early file filtering and optional Graph Views.
